Jackson State Community College - Student Center Updates

SBC Number 166/019-02-2025: Renovation of Jackson State Community College’s existing Student Center, including a new accessible entry vestibule, new masonry and metal panel cladding, storefront, and TPO roof, along with interior updates to offices, student supply spaces, and finishes. Mechanical, electrical, and fire protection systems will be reworked to fit the new layout, and the GC is responsible for all utility connections, including tap fees, meters, and transformer work.

Entities obtaining Bidding Documents become Bidders of Record for notifications. Bidders of Record may purchase hard copies of Bidding Documents from the same source (nonrefundable).

Bidders shall be licensed and qualified per state law. Five percent (5%) Bid Security is required in the form of a Bid Bond or check (certified or cashier’s) made payable to State of Tennessee. Non-discrimination policy applies.

Scope of Work:

This project consists of the renovation of the existing Student Center building at Jackson State Community College. Scope of work includes demolition of the existing exterior brick veneer, exterior storefront doors and windows, and the existing EPDM roof membrane. Interior renovations include partial demolition of existing walls, doors & hardware, ceilings, light fixtures, flooring and associated millwork elements. New construction work includes a new accessible entry vestibule, new exterior masonry veneer and metal panel cladding, new storefront windows and doors, & a new TPO roof membrane. Interior renovations include new wall partitions for new offices and student supply spaces, and finish upgrades throughout the areas of work. The existing mechanical, electrical and fire protection systems will be re-worked as needed for the new interior partition, ceiling, and lighting layouts.

  1. Additionally, the General Contractor shall ensure to include the following as a part to the Work:

  2. All utilities as required for building operation both from inside the building(s) to 5'-0" outside the building(s), and from 5'-0" outside the building(s) to the appropriate main service line as coordinated with utilities provider or other applicable city officials. This includes tap fees, meters, connections, electrical transformer and pad (as required), and all other Work related to utility provision and installation as required for complete operation.
